text:
Asking rents in Hanover stand at a median of 11.38 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.3% on the year and +24.6% over five years. That ranks Hanover #19 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 58% above the 2022 average contract rent of 7.21 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 683 € a month in cold rent, 15.3% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 27 days and 26% are gone within a week; with 2.2% market-active vacancy and +1.8% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 12.04 €/m² (+5.8%), with an 80% range of 11.72 to 12.33 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
